description: Kleine Scheidegg is the railway saddle between the Eiger and the Lauberhorn, and the station, with its tracks and dark hotels, sits in Lauterbrunnen a few metres from Grindelwald. The Eiger wall rises beside the platforms and disappears into cloud, so this is the pass, not the meadow portrait from the valley. No hotel name is readable. The Open-Meteo weather code is partly cloudy, with cloud cover near complete, and the air is cool and dry, with a breeze and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
